modmenu.descriptionTranslation.borderles: Let u play Minecraft in fullskreen wif no bordr. Kthx.
borderlessmc.options.fullscreenType.tool: Pick wich fullskreen mode u get wen §ofullskreen§r iz §oon§r in §ovideo settingz§r.
borderlessmc.options.borderlessFullscree: Pick wich fullskreen mode u get wen §ofullskreen§r iz §ono bordr§r in §ovideo settingz§r.
borderlessmc.options.useDelayedFullscree:
Waitz til Minecraft iz all loaded b4 goin fullskreen.

Turnin dis on can mak startup moar smooth an fix rare driver oopsies wer window cant go fullskreen rite away at diffrunt rez.
borderlessmc.options.useScaledFramebuffe:
Usez full-rez framebuffr on platformz wer skreen coordz can be scaley vs pixelz, liek §omacos§r an §owayland (Linux)§r.

Turnin dis off can giv moar speedz but less pretty pixelz.
borderlessmc.options.pauseOnLostFocus.to: Paws teh gaem automagically wen window no has focus.
borderlessmc.options.pauseOnLostFocusDur: Wen §opaws wen focus gone§r iz on, dis sayz if it also happenz in multiplayr, wer gaem cant rly paws.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:w:
Windowed fullskreen mode. Speedz an UX depend on ur platform.

On §lwindows§r, dis iz usually bestest: no-bordr goodness wif almost no speed or latency bonk. But sum ppl get annoyin blinky wen window getz or losez focus.

On §lothr platformz§r, dis can eat fps or be weird, liek dock stayin visible or sit on top of gaem.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:d:
Minecraft default exclusive fullskreen.

Big speedz an tiny latency, but gaem minimizez every tiem window losez focus. Sad.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.minecraft:h:
Minecraft default non-exclusive fullskreen.

Middle kitteh between exclusive an no-bordr fullskreen. Gud if u want overlayz or IME stuff but dont need true no-bordr.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.linux:borde:
Default no-bordr fullskreen for Linux.

Big speedz, tiny latency, no known bad stuff. Very gud.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.macos:borde:
Default no-bordr fullskreen for macOS.

Decent speedz, but lil moar latency than exclusive fullskreen cuz os putz V-Sync on windowed appz.
borderlessmc.fullscreenTypes.windows:win:
True windowed fullskreen for Windows.

Unliek §ominecraft:windowed§r, no annoyin blinky, but also no same speedy benefitz.

Latency iz higher than exclusive fullskreen cuz os v-syncz windowed appz. Windows can also sometimez yeet framez wen it thinkz background stuff iz moar important.
